title: Group Profile
body:
The results on the Group Profile page are displayed in five tabs. They are:

* Providers 
* Maps 
* Hierarchy
* Networks
* Attributes

## Providers Tab

This is the default tab. Providers within the group location with NPI, Client ID, specialty and address along with color-coded confidence are displayed in individual cards.  

For more information color-coded confidence, see [Confidence Scores](/#!/help/sections/glossary?s=c&t=confidence-scores) in the Glossary.

![](/cms/cms-assets/media/look-up-a-group-providerstab1.png)

To see more details about each provider in the group, click the provider name in the card. The Provider Profile page appears. 

![](/cms/cms-assets/media/look-up-a-group-provider-profile-page.png)

For more details on the Provider Profile page, see [Provider Profile](/#!/help/sections/using-network360/sections/provider-profile-1) help content.

## Map Tab

The Map tab shows the location(s) of the Group on a map.

If there is only one provider within the group at that location, the map will show a map pin. When you however over that map pin, the address for that provider will be displayed in a pop-up.

The screenshots below show a group location with only one provider at that location.

![](/cms/cms-assets/media/look-up-a-group_mapstab.png)

![](/cms/cms-assets/media/look-up-a-group_mapstab2.png)

If there is more than one provider in the group at the same location or proximity of a location, the map icon indicates that there are multiple providers and the number of providers will be displayed as a pop-up when hovering over the icon on the map.

![](/cms/cms-assets/media/look-up-a-group_mapstab3.png)

If you click on the multiple providers icon, the image will expand to show a map pin for each provider. Hovering over each map pin will show the specific provider and their address.

![](/cms/cms-assets/media/look-up-a-group_maptab4.png)

The map pins used to indicate each individual provider are color-coded indicating confidence levels: green for high, yellow for medium, and red for low, as shown in the above screenshot.

For more information see [Confidence Scores](/#!/help/sections/glossary?s=c&t=confidence-scores) in the Glossary.

Clicking on a map pin displays the Provider Profile page. 

For more details on the Provider Profile page, see [Provider Profile](/#!/help/sections/using-network360/sections/provider-profile-1) help content.

## Hierarchy Tab

The Hierarchy tab in the Group Profile illustrates how a Medical Group fits into a broader organizational framework. Groups are composed of individual or facility providers, while organizations represent higher-level entities that may encompass multiple groups or other affiliated organizations. The hierarchy reveals relationships such as ownership, affiliations, and shared contractual agreements.

If you are interested in adding hierarchy data to your Network360 subscription, please contact your account manager or contact our account management team. 

## Networks Tab

This tab displays an aggregated list of Networks that are accepted by the group. (i.e. all networks accepted by providers in any of the group locations). Keep in mind that not all networks may be accepted in all group locations nor by all providers within the group. 

![](/cms/cms-assets/media/look-up-a-group_group-profile-page-networks-tab.png)

## Attributes Tab

This tab displays specialty custom attributes, if configured.

If a project is configured with custom attributes, then this information is visible on a provider’s profile, and you can select the option to display Custom Attributes.

For more information see [Custom Attributes](/#!/help/sections/glossary?s=c&t=custom-attributes) in the Glossary.
